newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom Mobiles 1996 sales soar.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom Mobiles 1996 sales soar.

text.p: France Telecom Mobiles (FTM), the mobile phone and paging services branch of state-owned France Telecom, said on Tuesday that sales rose 72 percent last year to 11.2 billion francs.
The managing director of the division, Michel Bertinetto, also said FTM's cellular phone business, Itineris, was expected to break even in 1997, a year behind schedule.
Bertinetto told a news conference that FTM's sales on a like-for-like basis rose 45 percent. The activities of France Telecom Mobiles Services were first integrated last year.
He said FTM had more than four million clients in France and abroad in 1996 for its cell phone, paging and other services.

Itineris has 1.4 million subscribers, up from 1.3 million at the end of December, he said. He said the objective was to increase subscriptions by one million this year. He added that a promotional campaign would be launched in March.
FTM is vying for half the French mobile phone market, which is estimated to grow to 10 million clients by the year 2,000.
The paging service had turnover in 1996 of 600 million francs with 674,000 subscribers. FTM is aiming for one million subscribers by the end of the year.
FTM's international activities last year totalled two billion francs.
